simple.summary: אֲבִימָאֵל (ʼĂbîymâʼêl) means Abimael , a son of Joktan First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 22.

definitions.full: H39. Abimael אֲבִימָאֵל proper name, masculine ( a father is El ; South-Arabic name) son of Joktan Gen 10:28 ; 1Chr 1:22 . compare Sabean אבמעתֿתר , Abmi ±A¾tar a father is ±A¾tar ([ עשׁתר ] see עַשְׁתֹּרֶת ) Hal M 86 , DHM ZMG 1883, 18 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe);
